name: Elven Fighter
notes: Table 1.1 (shared base table of Eva's Templar, Sword Muse, Wind Rider and Moonlight Sentinel).
Pick the single-target skill by the equipped weapon: Power Strike = SWORD/BLUNT, Mortal Blow = DAGGER, Power Shot = BOW. A future tank or SWS uses a sword, a future WR a dagger, a future MS a bow.
Per line: Eva's Templar and Sword Muse play 1.1 with a sword (Power Strike), Wind Rider with a dagger (Mortal Blow), Moonlight Sentinel with a bow (Power Shot).

rows.trig: On reuse while the mob HP > 30 %. Power Strike = the SWORD/BLUNT pick (future tank / SWS).
On reuse while the mob HP > 30 %. Mortal Blow = the DAGGER pick (future WR).
On reuse while the mob HP > 30 %. Power Shot = the BOW pick (future MS); 700 range, 6 s reuse.
AoE: none. Fight one mob at a time.
rows.why: guide: no AoE skill in this band
